questions.stem: I ______ my grandparents last weekend. We had a great time together.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般过去时与现在完成时的区别。句中有明确的过去时间状语"last weekend"（上周末），这是典型的一般过去时标志词，表示过去某个特定时间发生的动作。现在完成时（have visited）强调过去动作对现在的影响或与现在的联系，不能与表示过去的具体时间短语连用。C选项是一般现在时，用于表示习惯或客观事实；D选项是现在进行时，表示正在进行的动作。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ______ I bought yesterday is about environmental protection.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系代词的选择。先行词是"the book"（书），指物，且在从句中作宾语（I bought the book），因此要用关系代词which或that。Who指代人且在从句中作主语；whom指代人且在从句中作宾语；whose表示"……的"，在从句中作定语。解题技巧：先行词指人用who/whom/that，指物用which/that，作定语用whose。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These trees ______ by the students every spring to make our school greener.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语"these trees"（这些树）是动作"plant"（种植）的承受者，因此要用被动语态，结构为be+过去分词。时间状语"every spring"（每年春天）表示经常性、习惯性的动作，应用一般现在时的被动语态"are planted"。D选项是一般过去时的被动语态，用于表示过去某个特定时间发生的被动动作，与"every spring"不符。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Could you tell me ______? I need to hand in the report tomorrow.
options: C. where does the library open
questions.explanation: 本题考查宾语从句的语序。宾语从句必须使用陈述句语序（主语+谓语），不能用疑问句语序。A和C选项使用了疑问句语序（is/does放在主语前），应排除。D选项结构不完整，缺少谓语动词。B选项"where the library is"是正确的陈述句语序（the library为主语，is为谓语）。解题口诀：宾语从句用陈述，主语谓语不调换。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: It's important to ______ your pet when you're free. Don't just leave it alone at home.
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。根据句意"当你有空时要______你的宠物，不要把它独自留在家"，可知需要表示"照顾"的含义。Look after表示"照顾、照料"；look for表示"寻找"；look up表示"查阅（词典）、向上看"；look at表示"看"。根据语境，照顾宠物是合理搭配。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The word 'unhappy' can be divided into 'un-' and 'happy'. The prefix 'un-' means ______.
questions.explanation: 本题考查前缀含义。Un-是常见的否定前缀，表示"不、非"，如unhappy（不开心的）、unhealthy（不健康的）、unable（不能的）。Re-表示"再次"，如rewrite（重写）；-ful是后缀，表示"充满……的"，如careful（小心的）；dis-也表示否定，但通常用于动词或名词前，如dislike（不喜欢）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We should pay more attention to the ______ of the environment around us.
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。定冠词"the"后面需要接名词，构成"the + 名词 + of"结构。Protect是动词（保护），protected是过去分词或形容词，protection是名词（保护），protective是形容词（保护的）。因此选C。句意：我们应该更加关注对周围环境的保护。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 本题考查语境理解和动词搭配。根据上下文"他们______一场与校长的会议并解释了他们的计划"，have/hold a meeting是固定搭配，表示"召开会议"。Missed（错过）、forgot（忘记）、refused（拒绝）均不符合语境，因为后文提到校长很支持，说明会议成功召开了。

questions.group_passage:
Our school started a recycling program last month. The idea came from a group of students who wanted to make our campus greener. They (8)______ a meeting with the headmaster and explained their plan. The headmaster was very supportive and agreed to help them.

The program works like this: students collect plastic bottles, waste paper and old books. They put these items into special bins (9)______ around the school. Every Friday afternoon, volunteers sort the materials and send them to recycling centers. In return, the centers give the school some money.

So far, the program has been very successful. We (10)______ over 500 kilograms of waste. The money earned will be used to buy new plants for the school garden. "It's amazing to see how small actions can make a big (11)______," said Li Ming, one of the student leaders. "Everyone can help protect the environment in daily life."

The program has also changed students' habits. Many of us now think twice before (12)______ away things that can be reused. Our school hopes more schools will start similar programs to protect our planet.

questions.explanation: 本题考查语境推理。Bins（垃圾桶、回收箱）应该是被"放置"在学校各处供学生使用。Placed表示"放置"，符合语境。Hidden（隐藏）不符合逻辑，因为回收箱需要被看见才能使用；locked（锁上）也不合理，因为学生需要随时投放；drawn（画）与bins搭配不当。

questions.stem: According to the survey mentioned in the passage, about ______ of teenagers spend more than 3 hours on their phones every day.
questions.explanation: 本题是细节理解题。根据文章第二段第一句"According to a recent survey... about 60% of teenagers aged 12 to 15 spend more than 3 hours on their phones every day"可知，大约60%的青少年每天使用手机超过3小时。细节题解题技巧：先读题干找关键词（如survey, 3 hours），然后回原文定位具体句子，仔细比对选项与原文信息。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Smartphones have become an important part of our daily life. They help us communicate with friends, study online and entertain ourselves during free time. With just a few taps, we can access endless information and connect with people worldwide. However, using smartphones too much can cause serious problems that many teenagers don't realize.

According to a recent survey conducted by a medical center, about 60% of teenagers aged 12 to 15 spend more than 3 hours on their phones every day. Many of them check their phones every few minutes, even during meals or right before sleeping. This behavior, commonly called "phone addiction" (手机上瘾), affects both their physical health and academic performance. Students who use phones excessively often have trouble concentrating in class and suffer from poor eyesight.

Dr. Wang, a well-known psychologist, explains that phone addiction happens because apps are specifically designed to attract and hold our attention. The colorful icons, endless scrolling features and instant notifications (即时通知) trigger our brains to release dopamine, a chemical that makes us feel happy and rewarded. That's exactly why we find it increasingly difficult to put down our phones even when we know we should.

Fortunately, there are effective ways to solve this problem. First, turn off unnecessary notifications so you won't be disturbed by constant buzzing all the time. Second, set a strict "phone-free" time each day, such as during dinner or at least one hour before bedtime. Third, find other meaningful hobbies like reading paper books, playing basketball or learning a musical instrument to replace excessive screen time.

Remember, technology should serve us as a useful tool, not control our lives. Using phones wisely and moderately helps us enjoy a healthier, more balanced and meaningful life.

questions.stem: The underlined word "trigger" in Paragraph 3 probably means ______ in Chinese.
questions.explanation: 本题是词义猜测题。根据第三段语境，"色彩鲜艳的图标、无限滚动功能和即时通知______我们的大脑释放多巴胺"，结合常识可知，这些手机功能会刺激大脑释放化学物质。Trigger意为"触发、引发"，与"cause"或"start"意思相近。词义猜测技巧：通过上下文逻辑关系（因果、递进）和常识判断。后文提到"这就是为什么我们很难放下手机"，说明前文讲的是手机吸引注意力的机制，因此"触发"最符合语境。

E. They can offer you support and helpful advice.
questions.explanation: 本题考查逻辑衔接和代词指代。空格前一句提到"当你感到焦虑或沮丧时，不要犹豫去和朋友、父母或老师谈谈"，空格处应说明为什么要寻求他们的帮助。选项E"他们可以提供给你支持和有用的建议"中，They指代前文提到的friends, parents or teachers，逻辑连贯。A、B、C、D都是段落主旨句，不适合放在此处作为细节补充。
questions.label: 短文填空
questions.group_passage:
Building healthy habits is important for everyone, especially for busy students who need to balance study and rest. Good habits not only keep us physically fit but also help us perform better in school. Here are some practical tips to help you live a healthier and happier life.

(17)______ First, try to go to bed before 10:30 p.m. and wake up at the same time every day, even on weekends. Getting enough sleep helps your brain work better, improves your memory and strengthens your immune system. Avoid using electronic devices at least one hour before bedtime.

(18)______ You don't need to run marathons or go to expensive gyms. Simple activities like brisk walking, cycling around your neighborhood or playing ball games with classmates for 30 minutes every day can make you stronger, more energetic and better at handling stress.

(19)______ Eat more fresh fruits and vegetables instead of junk food and sugary drinks. Remember to have a nutritious breakfast every morning because it provides the essential energy you need for the whole morning. Try to eat regularly and never skip meals.

Finally, stay positive and learn to manage your stress effectively. When you feel worried or depressed, don't hesitate to talk to your friends, parents or teachers. (20)______ Remember that small but consistent changes in your daily routine can lead to significant improvements in your overall health. Start with these simple steps today and you will feel the difference soon!
